q: Why did Harpic revenue change this month compared with last month?
answer:
Harpic revenue for MTD compared with the previous period (same days last month) fell by ₹55,666 (-7.7%) to ₹6.7 L.

• Volume was the largest negative driver, reducing revenue by ₹93,632 due to fewer units sold.
• Mix effect also weighed on sales (-₹18,263) as customers shifted to lower-priced SKUs, offset partly by a price/discount effect of +₹56,229.
• The biggest SKU drop came from Harpic Variant 3 (-₹63,839), while the East region suffered the sharpest regional decline (-₹2,15,480).
• Supporting pressures included an increase in stock-out risk (7.2% vs 3.6%), a drop in average customer rating (3.29 vs 3.44), and a drop in promo revenue share to 0.0% from 52.5%.

q: How is the competitor activity index calculated?
answer:
The competitor activity index is calculated as the sum of event weights multiplied by one plus the absolute value of price impact percent divided by ten, scaled to a thirty day period.
The weights assigned to events are three for price cuts, two for new launches, and one for TV campaigns.
This metric is recorded per manufacturer rather than per brand, with lower index values indicating less competitor activity.

q: How are competitors matched to our variants?
answer:
• Competitors are matched based on SubCategory only because all 11 brands have SKUs in more than one Category.
• External competitors are the external SKUs present in the same sub-categories as the core brand.
• The closest rival counts external competitors only, defined as the brand present in the most of the core brand's variants.
